On the bridge now — quick diagnostic summary before we dive deeper:
- Observed symptom: increasing request queue depth on the reserved GPU pool leading to stall/backpressure; p50/p95 token generation latency elevated, p99 spiking.
- Error pattern: majority 503s map to enqueue timeouts on the worker pool; small subset are OOMs during long context runs.
- Recent change: a canary burst from hosted routing two hours prior pushed additional cross-tenant reuse to the same GPU shard. Autonomous batching limits were hit.

Short-term mitigations (30–90m):
1) Temporarily raise parallel slot cap for NorthStar reservation by 20% to relieve queueing (requires routing update and throttling policy tweak).
2) Evacuate low-priority hosted traffic from the affected shard (manual reroute) to free slots.
3) Rate-limit extremely long-context calls at the edge (>5k tokens) to avoid OOMs.

We can implement 1+2 within ~25 minutes; 3 requires a conservative edge config (10–20 minutes). We'll monitor errors and latencies post-change and revert if we trigger collateral impact.

I’ll also attach a short mitigation plan and the commands we’ll run.
— Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 23:45:00 -0700
Subject: Post-mitigation update — stabilized, follow-ups

Update after actions completed:
- Actions taken at 23:15 PDT: raised NorthStar parallel slots + manual reroute of hosted shard traffic + applied short-term edge rate-limit for >5k token calls.
- Immediate effect: queue depth dropped ~65% within 6 minutes; p95 latency returned to baseline within ~12 minutes; 5xx rate reduced to pre-incident levels. No collateral impact observed on other high-priority tenants in monitored windows.
- Root cause hypothesis: a coincident burst from hosted canary traffic aggressively reused GPU shard leading to sustained queueing; autoscaling thresholds did not trigger fast enough under the mixed-workload pattern.

Next steps (action items):
- Engineering: propose a permanent routing isolation rule for reserved shards and adjust autoscaling sensitivity for mixed workloads (ETA: 2 business days).
- Product/Commercial: Marissa/Tessa to propose a goodwill package (credit + free reserved headroom trial) to NorthStar and close retention risk (ETA: 1 business day).
- Ops: create a runbook item for immediate manual reroute and on-call play (JIRA-OPS-3344).

I'll follow up with a post-incident write-up and add traces.
— Karthik
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
